question_evidence_quote: takes out all the face cards and the 8's
observed_error: The response counts only three face cards in a standard deck.
violated_condition: Each of the four suits contains a Jack, Queen, and King, so removing all face cards removes 12 cards.
error_description: The response counts Jack, Queen, and King as three individual face cards, omitting their occurrence in each of four suits. Consequently, it uses an incorrect number of removed and remaining cards. The written addition of 3 and 4 is correct; the face-card count violates the standard-deck condition.
secondary_errors: The response independently claims three red cards for each divisible-by-3 rank. Each rank has only two red cards, one heart and one diamond, so its favorable-outcome count is incorrect.
